summary: Paperclip holds only application letters and labels for NDA207500 (CRESEMBA / isavuconazonium sulfate); no FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader, Medical, or Risk reviews) that would describe an advisory committee are available in paperclip for this application. Searches of the available original (Orig1s000) application letter and label for 'Advisory Committee', 'committee', 'vote', and 'recommend' found no mention of an FDA advisory committee meeting; the only 'committee' references are to the trial's independent Data Review Committee, a blinded efficacy-adjudication body, not an FDA advisory committee. Based on the documents available in paperclip there is no evidence that an advisory committee was convened for this approval, and no verbatim passage explicitly states one was or was not held.
